claims_limit: One run per arm supports narrow observations only. Exact model/build unavailable, labels visible, several cases batched, H02 followup exposed early. H03 consumed by repair and then source recovery assisted after initial inconclusive result. H04 fresh case authored before patch, but executed in shared H03/H04 context. No broad superiority or complete unassisted independent-protocol success claim is supported.

conditions.reason: All six baseline-passing cases remain candidate-passing and all five behavioral hard gates pass. This gate does not waive unavailable musts or context/script protocol limitations.

fail_if.reason: No baseline-passing case regression or behavioral hard-gate failure observed.

comparison.reason: Fixed-script candidate satisfies 49/50 required conditions, passes 8/8 development and 3/4 held-out labels, with H03-M2 initially unavailable. Assisted H03 continuation supplies missing actual content inspection and meets content conditions but cannot erase original inconclusive run or become unassisted equal-script adoption evidence. Comparable unassisted cases show +6 satisfied conditions, no baseline-case regression and no behavioral hard-gate failure. Batched contexts and H02 early followup exposure also prevent a claim that the frozen independent-context protocol fully ran. Retain prior active version and preserve candidate/evidence under unchanged inconclusive rule.

excluded_from_comparable_benefit.H03: Final content-inspection completion required coordinator-supplied URL and extra continuation outside frozen script; do not count assisted result as equal-effort improvement.

publication_authority.evidence: D02 leaves publication/visibility for user choice; H01 preserves authorized public route but requires actual missing owner/tool capability; no publication occurred.

settled_decisions.evidence: No unnecessary settled-decision question; D01,D04,D06,D08 explicit local choices preserved; D06 correction applied.

draft_now.evidence: All explicit draft-now cases provide useful drafts without required interview/approval.

bounded_interviewing.evidence: Candidate D03 1/1/1 decisions, D05 1/0, H02 1/1; no question budget exceeded.

unsupported_research_claims.evidence: Actual D07 delegation/content/rights traces; H03 initial failure and assisted recovery disclosed; H04 real direct inspections; no unsupported tool/artifact/publication claims.

assisted_completion_supplement.reason: Coordinator-supplied corrected URL and extra continuation followed first draft and initial unavailable condition; original observation and grade remain preserved. Fully independent case contexts were also unavailable.

independent_context_subset_sensitivity.reason: Excludes batched simple cases, shared H03/H04 and H02 early-followup exposure; narrow observed gains remain, without claiming broad superiority.
